PHT_ENGINE_REGEN: build_stimuli will regenerate PHT to canonical PR placement (phantom superior on capacity only, unavailable) per the geometry rules (Web Appendix B). Values here are the V1 web appendix PHT-4 baseline.

stimuli.stem: Imagine you are shopping for a backpack. You are considering the following options:
stimuli.source: REBUILT (V1 web appendix SOT-4 used old geometry: added a middle option at 35L/$34.99, making HD the top extreme; new plan requires two BIN options PLUS one NEW EXTREME beyond HD so former HD becomes the middle). New extreme: 50L/$49.99. Former HD (40L/$39.99) is now geometrically the middle option on both attributes. NOTE: build_stimuli engine will regenerate SOT to a new extreme beyond HD.
flags: SOT_GEOMETRY_REBUILT: V1 SOT-4 used old 'add a middle' geometry (Middle=35L/$34.99, HD=40L/$39.99 remained the top). New plan requires adding an extreme BEYOND HD so HD becomes the middle. Rebuilt with new extreme at 50L/$49.99.
SOT_MIDDLE_VERIFIED: HD (40L/$39.99) is strictly between HF (30L/$29.99) and EXTREME (50L/$49.99) on both capacity (30 < 40 < 50) and price ($29.99 < $39.99 < $49.99).
SOT_ENGINE_REGEN: build_stimuli engine will regenerate the extreme value based on calibration; this placeholder uses 50L/$49.99 as a reasonable initial value.

stimuli.stem: Imagine you are shopping for a backpack. You are considering the following options:
stimuli.source: V1 web appendix SYM-4 exact values; decoy (30L/$39.99) is dominated by BOTH focal options: dominated by HF (same capacity 30L, higher price $39.99 > $29.99) AND dominated by HD (lower capacity 30L < 40L, same price $39.99). Same-page presentation mandatory per the geometry rules (Web Appendix B).
flags: SYM_DOUBLE_DOMINANCE_CONFIRMED: decoy (30L/$39.99) beaten by HF on price at equal capacity, beaten by HD on capacity at equal price.
SYM_SAME_PAGE: same-page flag required per Evangelidis et al. 2023; effect dies on separate pages.

stimuli.stem: Imagine you are shopping for a backpack. You are considering the following options:
stimuli.source: CONSTRUCTED (no published analog for SIM in Evangelidis et al. 2023 or any V1 source). Clone is near-duplicate of HD: same capacity (40L), price 41.99 vs HD's 39.99 (minimal upward step of $2.00). Clone is NOT dominated by HD: clone has same capacity (40L = 40L) and higher price ($41.99 > $39.99), so HD beats clone on price but not on both attributes simultaneously. Clone is same is_hd=true as HD. NOTE: build_stimuli engine will regenerate SIM to a non-dominated clone.
flags: SIM_NO_PUBLISHED_ANALOG: no Evangelidis et al. 2023 or V1 stimulus exists for the similarity structure. Constructed minimally per the geometry rules (Web Appendix B) SIM geometry.

SIM_NON_DOMINANCE_CONFIRMED: clone (40L/$41.99) is NOT dominated by HD (40L/$39.99) because clone price $41.99 > HD price $39.99 (HD beats clone on price but equal on capacity; not strictly dominated on both); clone is not dominated by HF (30L/$29.99) because clone capacity 40L > HF capacity 30L. Guard against Berkowitsch rounding accident: validate that clone does not silently become a decoy.
SIM_CLONE_OF_HD: clone shares is_hd=true with HD; distance on price is $2.00 (minimal); capacity is identical.
SIM_ENGINE_REGEN: build_stimuli engine will regenerate SIM to ensure non-dominance and minimal distance per the geometry rules (Web Appendix B) geometry.
